author: GitHub
description:
Waiting on a teammate just to get a routine pull request approved can stall team velocity. With delegated code review approvals, GitHub Copilot can evaluate your pull request and provide an assessment that counts directly toward your merge protection rules. Combine Copilot's automated review with a single human approval to satisfy branch requirements without the usual bottlenecks.
